correctness.rationale: The trace-six model splits to the standard six-coordinate cubic over an algebraic closure. In characteristic at least seven the singular gradient equation forces exactly three plus and three minus signs, giving ten ordinary nodes. Fifteen explicit matching planes exist in every permitted characteristic. A plane is incident with a node if and only if all its three matching edges cross the node triple split; counting gives sixty flags. Frobenius permutes the six embeddings in cycles of lengths equal to the factor degrees of the étale algebra. The standalone complete enumerator verifies all 720 permutations, all 11 cycle partitions and independent fixed-point identities of powers, establishing all orbit lengths and multiplicities. No unproved computational extrapolation is used. A claim about arbitrary other planes or the nonreduced full Fano scheme is deliberately excluded.

The exact 60-flag orbit spectra give every extension count, zeta function and simultaneous splitting degree. This is a motivated complete arithmetic classification of a canonical classical geometric incidence configuration; it is not an arbitrary chosen slice or unsupported downstream application.
